subject: general
question: Padma Bhushan awardee, Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam, was a renowned guru for which of the following classical dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam** was a legendary guru and choreographer in the** Kuchipudi dance **form.
 
• He founded the **Kuchipudi Art Academy in Chennai in 1963, **which became a premier institution for Kuchipudi training.
 
• Some of his notable disciples include** Shobha Naidu, Yamini Krishnamurthy, and Vani Ganapathy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathakali** is a highly **stylized dance-drama** form that originated in **Kerala.**
 
• **It **is known for its **elaborate makeup, costumes, and facial expressions.**
 
• **Kathak** is a **North Indian classical dance** form.
 
 
• It is known for its** intricate footwork and storytelling** through mime and gestures.
 
 
 
• **Odissi **is a classical dance form from **Odisha**.
 
 
• It is known for its** fluid movements, expressions, and sculpturesque poses.**
